```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

source(here::here("code", "_common.R"))
source(here::here("tracks", "fdic-brc-jfqa-aug2026", "code", "_track_common.R"))

save_figures <- TRUE
save_tables  <- TRUE

panel <- readRDS(latest_track_file("panel_smallbank"))
setDT(panel)

# Event window and post definition exactly as JMCB qmd (lines 207-209):
# window |k| < 12; post = 1 iff k > 0 (adoption quarter k = 0 is NOT post).
dt_w <- panel[abs(qtrs_since) < 12]
dt_w[, D_DT := as.factor(D_DT)]
dt_w[, post := ifelse(qtrs_since > 0, 1, 0)]

setFixest_fml(
  ..reg_dummy = ~ post * high_cecl_equity,
  ..reg_cont  = ~ post * cecl_equity,
  ..controls  = ~ log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1,
  ..fe = ~ ID_RSSD + D_DT,
  ..did_dummy = ~ i(qtrs_since, high_cecl_equity, ref = -1),
  ..did_cont  = ~ i(qtrs_since, cecl_equity, ref = -1),
  ..dv1.1 = ~ unins_time_deps_assets,
  ..dv1.2 = ~ ins_time_deps_assets,
  ..dv2.1 = ~ int_expense_assets,
  ..dv2.2 = ~ roa,
  ..dv2.3 = ~ nim
)

dict_did <- c(covariate_labels_dict, "(Intercept)" = "Constant")
order_did_tbl <- c("Post x CECL Adj", "Post x High CECL")
```

## §0 Baseline replication gate

```{r}
cat("\n================ §0 REPLICATION GATE ================\n")
cat("Compare against tracks/jmcb-june2026 Tables 3-5 / Figure 4.\n")

r0_dep <- list(
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.2 ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.2 ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
etable(r0_dep, dict = dict_did, order = order_did_tbl)
export_track_tbl(r0_dep, "tbl_did_time_deposits", dict_did, order_did_tbl)

r0_fin <- list(
  feols(..dv2.1 ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv2.1 ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv2.2 ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv2.2 ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv2.3 ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv2.3 ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
etable(r0_fin, dict = dict_did, order = order_did_tbl)
export_track_tbl(r0_fin, "tbl_did_financial_outcomes", dict_did, order_did_tbl)

# Event studies (uninsured / insured, binary + continuous)
rp_u_bin <- feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..did_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
rp_i_bin <- feols(..dv1.2 ~ ..did_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
rp_u_cont <- feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..did_cont + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
rp_i_cont <- feols(..dv1.2 ~ ..did_cont + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)

p <- make_es_plot(rp_u_bin, ylab_str = "Coefficient", title_str = "", vline_x = -1)
print(p); save_track_fig(p, "es_unins_time_deps_assets")
p <- make_es_plot(rp_i_bin, ylab_str = "Coefficient", title_str = "", vline_x = -1)
print(p); save_track_fig(p, "es_ins_time_deps_assets")
p <- make_es_plot(rp_u_cont, ylab_str = "Coefficient", title_str = "", vline_x = -1)
print(p); save_track_fig(p, "es_unins_time_deps_assets_cecl_cont")
p <- make_es_plot(rp_i_cont, ylab_str = "Coefficient", title_str = "", vline_x = -1)
print(p); save_track_fig(p, "es_ins_time_deps_assets_cecl_cont")

# Triple-difference (baseline bank x quarter FE)
unins <- copy(dt_w); unins[, dep_assets := unins_time_deps_assets]; unins[, deposit_uninsured := 1L]
ins   <- copy(dt_w); ins[, dep_assets := ins_time_deps_assets];     ins[, deposit_uninsured := 0L]
stacked <- rbind(unins, ins)
stacked[, deposit_uninsured := as.factor(deposit_uninsured)]
stacked <- stacked[!is.na(dep_assets)]
stacked[, bank_qt := paste0(ID_RSSD, "_", D_DT)]

dict_td <- c(dict_did,
             "deposit_uninsured1" = "Uninsured time dep",
             "bank_qt" = "Bank x Quarter")
order_td <- c("CECL Adj x Post x Uninsured time dep", "CECL Adj x Uninsured time dep",
              "CECL Adj x Post", "High CECL x Post x Uninsured time dep",
              "High CECL x Uninsured time dep", "High CECL x Post",
              "Post x Uninsured time dep")

r0_td <- list(
  feols(dep_assets ~ cecl_equity * post * deposit_uninsured + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | bank_qt,
        data = stacked, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(dep_assets ~ high_cecl_equity * post * deposit_uninsured + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | bank_qt,
        data = stacked, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
etable(r0_td, dict = dict_td, order = order_td)
export_track_tbl(r0_td, "tbl_triple_diff_time_deposits", dict_td, order_td)
```

## §1 Flexible characteristics-by-time controls (RA2/RB1)

```{r}
# 2022Q4 characteristics x quarter FE via fixest varying slopes.
chars_size <- c("log_ta_22q4", "equity_assets_22q4")
chars_mix  <- c(chars_size, "unins_dep_share_22q4", "brokered_share_22q4")
chars_full <- CHARS_22Q4

vs_fe <- function(chars) {
  as.formula(paste0("~ ID_RSSD + D_DT[", paste(chars, collapse = ", "), "]"))
}

r1_cont <- list(
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_cont + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_cont + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | .[vs_fe(chars_size)], data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_cont + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | .[vs_fe(chars_mix)],  data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_cont + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | .[vs_fe(chars_full)], data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
etable(r1_cont, dict = dict_did, order = order_did_tbl)
export_track_tbl(r1_cont, "tbl_flexcontrols", dict_did, order_did_tbl)

r1_bin <- list(
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | .[vs_fe(chars_size)], data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | .[vs_fe(chars_mix)],  data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | .[vs_fe(chars_full)], data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
etable(r1_bin, dict = dict_did, order = order_did_tbl)
export_track_tbl(r1_bin, "tbl_flexcontrols_binary", dict_did, order_did_tbl)

# Event study under the full characteristic set
rp_flex <- feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..did_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | .[vs_fe(chars_full)],
                 data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
p <- make_es_plot(rp_flex, ylab_str = "Coefficient", title_str = "", vline_x = -1)
print(p); save_track_fig(p, "fig_es_flexcontrols")

# Triple-diff under chars x quarter x deposit-type slopes (bank x quarter FE
# already absorbs chars x quarter; the relevant margin is chars x quarter x uninsured)
vs_fe_td <- as.formula(paste0("~ bank_qt + D_DT^deposit_uninsured[",
                              paste(chars_full, collapse = ", "), "]"))
r1_td <- list(
  feols(dep_assets ~ cecl_equity * post * deposit_uninsured + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | .[vs_fe_td],
        data = stacked, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(dep_assets ~ high_cecl_equity * post * deposit_uninsured + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | .[vs_fe_td],
        data = stacked, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
etable(r1_td, dict = dict_td, order = order_td)
export_track_tbl(r1_td, "tbl_flexcontrols_td", dict_td, order_td)
```

## §2 Adoption-timing tests (RB1)

```{r}
dt_w[, cohort := fifelse(adopt_dt <= as.Date("2022-12-31"), "Early (2022Q3-Q4)",
                  fifelse(adopt_dt == as.Date("2023-03-31"), "Main (2023Q1)",
                          "Late (2023Q2-Q4)"))]
cat("\nCohort sizes (banks, high-CECL banks):\n")
print(dt_w[, .(banks = uniqueN(ID_RSSD),
               high_cecl = uniqueN(ID_RSSD[high_cecl_equity == 1])), by = cohort])

# Event-time event studies by cohort (binary treatment), overlaid
cohorts <- c("Early (2022Q3-Q4)", "Main (2023Q1)", "Late (2023Q2-Q4)")
pd_list <- list(); ok <- character(0)
for (ch in cohorts) {
  m <- tryCatch(
    feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..did_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe,
          data = dt_w[cohort == ch], vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
    error = function(e) { cat("  [skip]", ch, ":", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL }
  )
  if (!is.null(m)) { pd_list[[ch]] <- extract_es_data(m); ok <- c(ok, ch) }
}
p_coh <- make_split_es_plot(pd_list, ok,
                            colors = c(primary_gold, primary_blue, negative_red)[seq_along(ok)],
                            title_str = "", ylab_str = "Coefficient")
print(p_coh); save_track_fig(p_coh, "fig_es_cohorts", width = 6, height = 3.5)

# Calendar-time version: i(D_DT, high_cecl_equity) by cohort, 2023Q1 marked.
# Reference = last quarter before the cohort's first adoption.
cal_refs <- c("Early (2022Q3-Q4)" = "2022-06-30",
              "Main (2023Q1)"     = "2022-12-31",
              "Late (2023Q2-Q4)"  = "2023-03-31")
cal_es <- function(dat, ref_lvl) {
  m <- feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ i(D_DT, high_cecl_equity, ref = ref_lvl) +
               log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1 + int_expense_assets_l1 |
               ID_RSSD + D_DT, data = dat, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
  cf <- coef(m); se_ <- se(m)
  idx <- grepl("^D_DT::", names(cf))
  pd <- data.table(date = as.Date(sub("^D_DT::([0-9-]+):.*", "\\1", names(cf)[idx])),
                   est = cf[idx], se = se_[idx])
  pd <- rbind(pd, data.table(date = as.Date(ref_lvl), est = 0, se = 0))
  setorder(pd, date)
  pd[, `:=`(lo90 = est - CI_Z * se, hi90 = est + CI_Z * se)]
  pd[]
}
pd_cal <- rbindlist(lapply(ok, function(ch) {
  pd <- tryCatch(cal_es(dt_w[cohort == ch], cal_refs[[ch]]),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(pd)) return(NULL)
  pd[, cohort := ch]; pd
}))
p_cal <- ggplot(pd_cal, aes(x = date, y = est, color = cohort, fill = cohort)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = accent_gray, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2023-03-31"), color = "darkred",
             linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2023-04-30"), y = Inf, label = "2023Q1 (SVB)",
           color = accent_gray, vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0, size = 2.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo90, ymax = hi90), alpha = 0.10, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(c(primary_gold, primary_blue, negative_red)[seq_along(ok)], ok)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = setNames(c(primary_gold, primary_blue, negative_red)[seq_along(ok)], ok)) +
  theme_custom() +
  labs(x = "Calendar quarter", y = "Coefficient", color = NULL, fill = NULL)
print(p_cal); save_track_fig(p_cal, "fig_es_cohorts_calendar", width = 6, height = 3.5)

# Drop-2023Q1-cohort DiD (early + late cohorts only)
dt_nomain <- dt_w[cohort != "Main (2023Q1)"]
cat(sprintf("\nDrop-2023Q1 sample: %d banks (%d high-CECL)\n",
            uniqueN(dt_nomain$ID_RSSD),
            uniqueN(dt_nomain[high_cecl_equity == 1, ID_RSSD])))
r2_drop <- list(
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_cont  + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_nomain, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_dummy + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_nomain, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
etable(r2_drop, dict = dict_did, order = order_did_tbl)
export_track_tbl(r2_drop, "tbl_cohort_timing", dict_did, order_did_tbl)

# Not-yet-adopted placebo: late-cohort banks, outcome = change in uninsured time
# deposits over 2023Q1 (the SVB quarter, before their own adoption); regressor =
# the bank's (future) CECL adjustment. Expected: zero.
late_ids <- unique(panel[adopt_dt >= as.Date("2023-06-30"), ID_RSSD])
cs_q4 <- panel[ID_RSSD %in% late_ids & D_DT == as.Date("2022-12-31"),
               .(ID_RSSD, unins_q4 = unins_time_deps_assets, cecl_equity,
                 high_cecl_equity, log_total_assets, equity_assets, int_expense_assets)]
cs_q1 <- panel[ID_RSSD %in% late_ids & D_DT == as.Date("2023-03-31"),
               .(ID_RSSD, unins_q1 = unins_time_deps_assets)]
cs_pl <- merge(cs_q4, cs_q1, by = "ID_RSSD")
cs_pl[, d_unins := unins_q1 - unins_q4]
r2_pl <- list(
  feols(d_unins ~ cecl_equity + log_total_assets + equity_assets + int_expense_assets,
        data = cs_pl, vcov = "hetero"),
  feols(d_unins ~ high_cecl_equity + log_total_assets + equity_assets + int_expense_assets,
        data = cs_pl, vcov = "hetero")
)
cat(sprintf("\nPlacebo sample: %d late-cohort banks\n", nrow(cs_pl)))
etable(r2_pl, dict = dict_did)
export_track_tbl(r2_pl, "tbl_placebo_notyet", dict_did)
```

## §3 Extended pre-trends, 2018Q1 onward (RA1/RA6)

```{r}
dt_long <- panel[D_DT >= as.Date("2018-03-31")]
dt_long[, D_DT := as.factor(D_DT)]
dt_long[, post := ifelse(qtrs_since > 0, 1, 0)]
covid_qtrs <- c("2020-03-31", "2020-06-30")
dt_long_nc <- dt_long[!(as.character(D_DT) %in% covid_qtrs)]

long_specs <- list(
  list(dat = "full",    dv = "unins_time_deps_assets", stub = "fig_es_long_unins"),
  list(dat = "nocovid", dv = "unins_time_deps_assets", stub = "fig_es_long_unins_nocovid"),
  list(dat = "full",    dv = "ins_time_deps_assets",   stub = "fig_es_long_ins"),
  list(dat = "nocovid", dv = "ins_time_deps_assets",   stub = "fig_es_long_ins_nocovid")
)
cat("\n--- Joint pre-trend tests (k <= -2), binary treatment ---\n")
for (s in long_specs) {
  dat <- if (s$dat == "full") dt_long else dt_long_nc
  m <- feols(.[s$dv] ~ i(qtrs_since, high_cecl_equity, ref = -1) +
               ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dat, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
  w <- wald(m, keep = "qtrs_since::-", print = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("  %-28s F=%.3f  p=%.3f\n", s$stub, w$stat, w$p))
  p <- make_es_plot(m, ylab_str = "Coefficient", title_str = "", vline_x = -1)
  if (s$dat == "full") {
    # COVID band drawn at k = -12/-11, the 2020Q1-Q2 position for the 2023Q1
    # cohort (92.5% of banks); approximate for other cohorts.
    p <- p + annotate("rect", xmin = -12.5, xmax = -10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                      fill = accent_gray, alpha = 0.15) +
      annotate("text", x = -11.5, y = -Inf, label = "COVID", color = accent_gray,
               vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5)
  }
  print(p); save_track_fig(p, s$stub, width = 6, height = 3)
}
```

## §4 Residualized CECL treatment (RA1)

```{r}
# cecl_resid = residual from 2022Q4 cross-section regression of cecl_equity on
# the expanded Table 2 predictor set (built in 01_build_panel; first stage Adj R2 = 0.013).
r4 <- list(
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ ..reg_cont + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv1.1 ~ post * cecl_resid + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv2.1 ~ ..reg_cont + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv2.1 ~ post * cecl_resid + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv2.2 ~ ..reg_cont + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(..dv2.2 ~ post * cecl_resid + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
etable(r4, dict = dict_did, order = c(order_did_tbl, "Post x CECL Adj (Residual)"))
export_track_tbl(r4, "tbl_resid_cecl", dict_did,
                 c(order_did_tbl, "Post x CECL Adj (Residual)"))

rp_resid <- feols(..dv1.1 ~ i(qtrs_since, high_cecl_resid, ref = -1) +
                    ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
p <- make_es_plot(rp_resid, ylab_str = "Coefficient", title_str = "", vline_x = -1)
print(p); save_track_fig(p, "fig_es_resid")
```

## §5 Alternative scalings (RA5)

```{r}
alt_tbl <- function(treat_cont, treat_bin, stub) {
  r <- list(
    feols(..dv1.1 ~ post * .[treat_cont] + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
    feols(..dv1.1 ~ post * .[treat_bin]  + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
    feols(..dv2.1 ~ post * .[treat_cont] + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
    feols(..dv2.1 ~ post * .[treat_bin]  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
    feols(..dv2.2 ~ post * .[treat_cont] + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
    feols(..dv2.2 ~ post * .[treat_bin]  + ..controls | ..fe, data = dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
  )
  print(etable(r, dict = dict_did, order = "Post x "))
  export_track_tbl(r, stub, dict_did, "Post x ")
  invisible(r)
}
alt_tbl("cecl_assets", "high_cecl_assets", "tbl_alt_scaling_assets")
alt_tbl("cecl_loans",  "high_cecl_loans",  "tbl_alt_scaling_loans")
```

## §6 Fully saturated triple-diff (RA-m3)

```{r}
# Columns (2)/(4): bank FE + quarter FE only, so all lower-order interactions are
# reported (post x cecl is identified off cohort variation in adoption timing).
r6 <- list(
  feols(dep_assets ~ cecl_equity * post * deposit_uninsured + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | bank_qt,
        data = stacked, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(dep_assets ~ cecl_equity * post * deposit_uninsured + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ID_RSSD + D_DT,
        data = stacked, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(dep_assets ~ high_cecl_equity * post * deposit_uninsured + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | bank_qt,
        data = stacked, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  feols(dep_assets ~ high_cecl_equity * post * deposit_uninsured + ..controls + int_expense_assets_l1 | ID_RSSD + D_DT,
        data = stacked, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
etable(r6, dict = dict_td, order = order_td)
export_track_tbl(
  r6, "tbl_triple_diff_saturated", dict_td, order_td,
  notes = paste("Columns (1) and (3) include bank-by-quarter fixed effects, which absorb",
                "Post, CECL Adj, and Post $\\times$ CECL Adj (all constant within",
                "bank-quarter); columns (2) and (4) replace them with bank and quarter",
                "fixed effects so all lower-order interactions are reported.")
)

cat("\n[main_results_20260612.qmd] complete.\n")
```
